title: The Holy Blood procession
episode: Procession of the Holy Blood in Bruges
description: UNESCO’s film on the procession held every Ascension Day since the 1300s, when a relic said to hold drops of Christ’s blood is carried through the streets. The rest of the year it is kept in the Basilica of the Holy Blood on the Burg.

title: Memling’s St. Ursula Shrine
description: Two art historians on the Shrine of St. Ursula, a gilded reliquary painted in 1489 by Hans Memling, a German-born painter who worked in Bruges for 30 years. It has never left St. John’s Hospital, for which it was made.
